scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for all complex q and every two-dimensional antilinear operator with A squared equal to a negative real scalar; finite checker is corroborative, not an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Other antilinear square relations, higher dimensions and mixed real-linear maps are not classified.
Earlier equivalent published two-dimensional constrained-numerical-range formulas may exist; independent publication-priority and mathematical audits have not been performed.
A plausible older source concerning ordinary antilinear numerical ranges was not available in full.
title: Exact \(q\)-numerical annuli of two-dimensional antilinear quaternionic roots
